draft.subject: Getting Maple Systems' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Sorry we missed each other last week — happy to work around your schedule. No reply needed if things are moving along.

If it's useful: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Starting with one real project rather than a test one tends to make the first week genuinely useful.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
